title: Durga Puja Holiday 2026
answer:
Durga Puja Holiday 2026 will be from 19 October 2026 (Monday) to 23 October 2026 (Friday).

Details:
• 19 October 2026 (Monday) - Durga Puja Maha Ashtami
• 20 October 2026 (Tuesday) - Durga Puja Maha Navami
• 21 October 2026 (Wednesday) - Vijaya Dashami / Dussehra
• 22 October 2026 (Thursday) - Additional Day for Durga Puja
• 23 October 2026 (Friday) - Additional Day for Durga Puja

Maha Saptami falls on Sunday, 18 October 2026, so it is not included in the holiday list.
